narrative.intro: Humana Government Business obligated $5.6B in FY2026 to date. Humana Government Business received 2 awards so far in the current fiscal year, with an average award size of $2.8B. Obligations fell 13.5% year over year. Humana Government Business has a multi-year history of federal contracting: FY21 obligations were $7.1B, FY22 obligations were $7.7B, FY23 obligations were $7.8B, FY24 obligations were $8B, and FY25 obligations were $6.5B. The current-year total is a partial fiscal year figure, so FY26 to date reflects obligations recorded through the reporting cutoff. The award-count and average-award-size figures show the current work is concentrated in a small number of large awards. The year-over-year decline quantifies the change between the most recent full-year comparison points. Readers tracking Humana Government Business should note the mix of large awards and the downward movement in obligations compared with the prior year.
